text:
Two bugs in `_refill`:

1. Tokens are never capped at `capacity`, so after a long idle period the bucket can hold more than `capacity` tokens.
2. `if self._last:` uses truthiness — when the clock starts at 0, `self._last` becomes `0.0` (falsy), so refill never happens again.
